title: hieracium juranum subsp. doronicoides
intro: Hieracium juranum subsp. doronicoides, commonly known as the hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium juranum subsp. doronicoides are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
